label: November 17, 2025
changes_html:
About This Vintage

This is a direct reconstruction of The Budget Lab's "State of U.S. Tariffs: November 17, 2025" report data. Unlike other vintages in this archive, the figures below are presented exactly as originally published — same figure numbers (T1, T2, F1–F7, etc.), same row/column layout, same multi-row headers where they existed in the source workbook — rather than remapped into this tool's standard cross-vintage figure schema. As a result, this vintage's figure IDs and table shapes will not line up one-to-one with other vintages in this archive.

tab.description: Appendix tables and figures from the November 17, 2025 report modeling the scenario in which the Supreme Court invalidates the administration's use of IEEPA as tariff authority, presented in their original published structure. Note that not every baseline table/figure has a corresponding appendix version — only those whose results are sensitive to IEEPA status were recomputed under this scenario in the original report.
